Name: AT- Pride Banners
Author: Amchro
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/UMYQlc0.png[/img]
"More Banners" uses the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mod, which gives the possibility to make retextures of the elements of the game.


[size=5][b][img]https://imgur.com/QSOf1J9.png[/img]
[/b][/size]All flags use the Pastel Banner as a base. (The Pastel Banner is purchased at the egg festival).
[b]To recolor you need to buy the Paint Bucket (you can buy it with Robin).

NOTE[/b]: If you have many recolors you can look for those of this mod by typing in the Alternative Textures search engine "Pride"

What other community flags do you want in the recolor?

Downloads.Description: Version update only to match AlternativeTextures mod
